name: mcp-plugin-sandbox
description: Sandbox plugin for testing Claude Code plugin auto-update flow. Bundles XcodeBuildMCP, an Evinced mobile MCP registration with userConfig-driven env injection, four iOS skills, and a SessionStart hook that auto-refreshes the marketplace catalog.

evinced_service_account_id.title: Evinced Service Account ID
evinced_service_account_id.description: Optional. UUID of your Evinced service account. Leave empty to fall back to Web Login auth.

evinced_access_token.title: Evinced Access Token
evinced_access_token.description: Optional. JWT for the Evinced service account. Leave empty to fall back to Web Login auth.
